SUA.description: A fixed monthly allowance on the contract, prorated by calendar days and paid share.

OVERTIME.description: Overtime beyond normal hours on a working day, and every hour on an off day, at a premium on the hour rate.

FUND.description: A flat-rate fund: the same share of ordinary wages from the employee and the employer.

TAX.employee_amount:
const fund = Object.hasOwn(ctx.statutory, 'FUND') ? ctx.statutory.FUND.employee : 0;
return (ctx.subtotals.ORDINARY_WAGES - fund) * ctx.lookup.rate;
TAX.description: A flat-rate tax on ordinary wages less the employee's fund share.

ANNUAL_LEAVE.description: Paid annual leave per service year, by length of service; unused days carry and pay out.

NPL.description: No-pay leave: each day taken reduces basic pay by one day.

MEDICAL_LEAVE.description: Paid sick leave, capped per calendar year by length of service.

PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_IN_LIEU.description: A paid day owed in place of a public holiday; HR grants each day by hand.
PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_IN_LIEU.payout:
const day = round(ctx.month_wage / 26, ctx.lookup.minor_unit, 'HALF_UP');
return day * Number(get(ctx.entry, 'quantity', 0));

MEDICAL_CLAIM.description: Reimburses a medical bill with net pay, at the amount entered, up to a yearly limit.

BONUS.description: A bonus at the amount entered.

BPAYBS.description: Back pay owed for an earlier period under terms signed later, at the amount entered or computed by the run.

EMPLOYER_SHUTDOWN.description: An employer shutdown that stops work.

input_schema.description: opened_on is the date the employer received notice; occurred_on is the accident date; severity is the injury classification.

ANNUAL_LEAVE_SERVICE.description: Applies the annual-leave service rules for unauthorised absence and long unpaid leave.
ANNUAL_LEAVE_SERVICE.condition:
if (get(ctx.entry, 'encashment', false) === true) return false;
return get(first(ctx.reads.leave_catalog), 'code', '') === 'ANNUAL_LEAVE';

TERMS_PARTICULARS_ISSUE.description: Raises a task to issue written particulars when an employment is recorded.
TERMS_PARTICULARS_ISSUE.name: TERMS_PARTICULARS_ISSUE

PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL.description: Raises a task to dispose of an ex-employee's personal data after the retention period.
PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL.name: PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL
